source_campaign: T005 AI за работа - тестова кампания (SPLIT, PROMISE, HERO)

banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The image must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames, no inner frame, no blurred strips).
LAYOUT (critical - the final banner is cut to 4:5 from the centre of this tall frame, so the top 15% and the bottom 15% are thrown away): the top 19% of the frame contains ONLY plain background. The headline starts at about 21% from the top. The bottom of the CTA button is at about 78% from the top. Everything below 80% is ONLY plain background. Keep about 7% side margins.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, from the top): 0-20% only background. 21-30% the headline (two lines, VERY BIG). 31-37% the subheadline (TWO lines). 38-70% the split scene with the book. 71-76% the CTA button. 79-100% only background.
FORMAT: SPLIT-PAIN - one photo split vertically in two halves with a thin bright vertical line in the middle (IMAGE 3 is our No.1 winning SPLIT banner - copy its structure: problem on the left, result on the right, book in the middle across the line; NOT its colours, people or texts).
Setting: an ordinary Bulgarian office (modest, not luxury). The woman is a Bulgarian office employee around 45, shoulder-length dark-brown hair, smart-casual blouse, natural look. The SAME woman and the SAME desk with a laptop in both halves.
LEFT HALF (the problem, cooler and darker evening light, window dark outside): she sits at the desk late, tired, rubbing her forehead, surrounded by tall piles of papers and folders; a plain round wall clock without numbers shows about half past six. Front three-quarter view; the laptop lid seen from the back is plain and clean.
RIGHT HALF (the result, warm bright daylight): the same woman relaxed and smiling, the desk tidy, she closes the laptop and picks up her handbag, ready to leave on time.
BOOK: the book (IMAGE 2) STANDS UPRIGHT on the desk, front cover facing the camera, leaning slightly back against a mug or a stack of folders, naturally lit, realistic size, clearly readable, not lying flat, not floating. The book stands in the bottom centre across the dividing line, about 28% of the banner width, clearly in front of both halves.
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline across the full width at the top on a soft dark gradient, white, heavy, VERY BIG, two lines: "Отчетът пак ли ти изяде цял ден?" - make "цял ден?" yellow #F5C518.
2) Subheadline under it, white, bold, medium size (about 4.5% of the banner height - clearly smaller than the headline, roughly 60% of the headline letter height), split on TWO lines: line 1 "Ето как да го направиш" / line 2 "10 пъти по-бързо с AI." (one sentence, exactly these words).
3) CTA button: "Научи СЕГА👉"
IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "AI за работа 2027" (it shows the cover design - use only the book itself). Reproduce it exactly on the physical book: dark navy cover, white title "AI ЗА РАБОТА", orange-yellow "2027", the two colleagues at a laptop, author "ДАНИЕЛА ПЕТРОВА" and the "Златен Ключ" logo - same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation, quotation marks and capital letters. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic).
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline at least ~4.8% of the banner height (bold, very easy to read on a phone), CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white text on dark areas or near-black text on light areas; accent words in yellow #F5C518; no grey text.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white text, centred near the bottom of the central area. The pointing-hand emoji at the end of the CTA is drawn as a small yellow pointing-right hand icon.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, percentages or website addresses anywhere. No phone screens, no chat or messenger interface, no notification badges.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each. Laptop lids seen from the back are plain and clean (no logos, no icons, no stickers). Screens show only soft blurred generic shapes, never readable text, never app logos.
BOOK REALISM (critical - the book must NOT look pasted in like a sticker): a real, physically present paperback in the scene, lit by the SAME light, soft natural shadow, realistic size (a normal 13x20 cm paperback). The cover design and title must still be recognisable and must stand out from what is behind it.
CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 80% of the frame height, with clear empty space below it.
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, shop names, street signs, wall lettering or written papers besides the book cover.
